items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Eddie's wife jumped up on the bandstand...his girlfriend, I mean. She jumped up on the bandstand and picked Eddie up.

ctx.x: of me and Eddie was on the other. So Eddie, he's half-high -- everybody's drinking New Year's Eve. And Lee is on this side of me. So Lee said something to me, so I bent down and I said, 'What did you say?' -- because I couldn't hear him, because of all the noise. And Eddie Vinson at that time, he saw Lee and I with our heads together, and he reached over and WHOMP, and he hit Lee Polk and jumped back... He hit Lee Polk, and Lee Polk got up there and WHAP! And Eddie sprawled out on the bandstand. And Cootie, he…

But Lee Polk hit him. You know, before the night was over they were standing at the bar drinkin'! Drinkin' some more. Well, see, now his complex told him that Lee Polk was talkin' about him. Lee Polk wasn't even thinking about him!
